cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a shaved ice shop — a hand-crank ice shaver, jars of fruit syrup, a frosty display cooler and wooden stools
cuts.scene: she is an apprentice at the counter with a bowl of shaved ice, careless with the syrup
cuts.outfit: a shaved ice maker look fitted to her body — a short white apron over a fitted tank top and short skirt, bare shoulders and legs, a plain blue paper hat
